title: What we recite while standing
intro: Subhanaka, A‘udhu billah, Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a short surah.

learn.html: After the opening Allaahu akbar we stand still, put our hands together and recite quietly:

learn.label: 1. Subhanaka – only in the first rak‘ah
learn.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ غَيْرُكَ
learn.tr: Subhaanakallaahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa ta‘aalaa jadduka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruk.
learn.en: Glory be to You, O Allah, and all praise is Yours. Blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god but You.

learn.label: 2. A‘udhu billah
learn.en: I seek Allah’s protection from the accursed Shaytan.

learn.label: 3. Bismillah
learn.en: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

learn.title: 4. Al-Fatiha – in every rak‘ah
learn.html: Then we recite Al-Fatiha and say Ameen quietly. Practise it in Learn the Surahs by Heart.

learn.title: 5. A short surah
learn.html: In the first two rak‘ahs we add a short surah, for example Al-Ikhlas, Al-Kawthar or Al-‘Asr.
Listen and repeat: Subhanaka with the recording.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Subhanaka → A‘udhu → Bismillah → Al-Fatiha → Ameen → a short surah.
